what: Each layout judged by its best feasible twist: among its ground-clear grasps, the best whose simulated twist keeps the fingers apart on the CAD collision spheres (hand-4a, 2026-11-20 00:0x; owner, 23:5x: "we should not be filtering bad hands because of collisions from infeasible trajectories, we should be judging them by their feasible trajectories").
